race.description: Jess & Rohan For Breakfast 90.9 Sea Fm Mdn Plate
race.comment: MARITIMO (4) is worth following up after going down narrowly here last time after racing wide throughout. Should be nearing a peak now and the rise in trip looks to suit. JUST SAY VALE (14) comes through a stronger metro line at Doomben, where she was a short odds-on favourite and still ran second after racing keenly and having difficulty getting clear late. SEATICFLASH (12) has been placed in three of four and was held up near the 300m when third at the Sunny Coast. The rise in trip suits and she can break through soon. SECRET FENKEL (7) resumes and while he's found the maiden win elusive it certainly hasn't been without trying. Fitted with a trial and is in the mix.
